SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — reconstructed for HEARTH Phase 1 from the clause
content described in spec v0.3 §2.5 / §12 P1-B. Not an executed agreement.
Layout modeled on a CREC-style exclusive right-to-buy contract as presented
by the Grey Rock brokerage on 2026-06-11.

EXCLUSIVE RIGHT-TO-BUY LISTING CONTRACT (BDB24-6-24)
(ALL TYPES OF PROPERTIES)
Grey Rock Realty Group LLC, Berthoud, Colorado
Date: June 11, 2026

1. AGREEMENT. Buyer engages Broker as Buyer's exclusive agent to locate and
negotiate the acquisition of real property as described in this Contract,
and Broker accepts that engagement.

2. BROKERAGE SERVICES AREA. This Contract applies to the purchase of any
real property by Buyer located anywhere in the State of Colorado, including
without limitation Larimer, Weld, and Boulder Counties.

3. TERM OF CONTRACT. This Contract begins on the date set forth above and
continues through December 31, 2026. The parties may extend the term by
written agreement.

4. BROKERAGE DUTIES. Broker will exercise reasonable skill and care for
Buyer as a buyer's agent, including presenting all offers in a timely
manner and disclosing to Buyer adverse material facts actually known by
Broker.

5. EARNEST MONEY. Broker may hold earnest money as provided in a Contract
to Buy and Sell Real Estate between Buyer and a seller.

6. OTHER BROKERS. Buyer agrees to conduct all negotiations for properties
in the Services Area only through Broker and to refer to Broker all
communications received from other brokers or sellers.

7. COMPENSATION TO BROKER. Buyer agrees that Broker's Success Fee shall be
3% of the Purchase Price of any property acquired by Buyer during the term
of this Contract, earned as set forth below.

7.1 PAYMENT SOURCE. Broker will first seek payment of the Success Fee from
the seller or the listing brokerage by separate written agreement.

7.3 ADDITIONAL COMPENSATION. If the Seller or the listing brokerage does
not pay all or any portion of the Success Fee, Buyer shall pay Broker the
unpaid balance at Closing.

7.4 HOLDOVER. If within ninety days after this Contract ends Buyer acquires
a property identified to Buyer by Broker during the term, the Success Fee
will be due as if the property were acquired during the term.

8. FEE EARNED ON DEFAULT. If Buyer defaults under any contract to purchase
a property in the Services Area, the Success Fee is earned, due, and
payable on the date of default, and the obligations of this Section
survive the expiration or termination of this Contract.

9. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Contract constitutes the entire agreement of the
parties relating to its subject matter and supersedes all prior agreements.
